articles.title: ZDI-26-561: (Pwn2Own) Home Assistant Green go2rtc Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Home Assistant Green. An attacker must first obtain the ability to access the device's localhost interface. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.5.
